name: Wingtip cruise propellers

mass_kg.source: calc.py: C0 6.182 kg (analysis/results.json sized.m) + 2 tip assemblies 1.024 kg - removed pusher gear 0.323 kg + battery-move wiring and rails 0.028 kg

cg_x_m.source: held at the C0 target (analysis/results.json cg.target, 28 pct MAC) by moving the battery from x 0.0605 to -0.1137 m; unmoved CG would be -0.0462 m

static_margin_pct.source: C0 19.632 pct (analysis/aero.json) minus 2.0 points for prop normal force: dNp = 2 CNa q A_disk (CNa 0.25-0.75 /rad, EST), arm 0.144 m, NP shift = dNp arm / (CLa q S); calc.py np_shift

width_m.source: 2 x (nacelle axis 1.228 + prop radius 0.1778); 3 m limit margin 0.188 m

hover_power_W.source: sizing F3 as P_hover = 4 x interp(thrust table, m g / 4) x kCtrl 1.1, calibrated to 831.98 W at 6.182 kg (calc.py); ratio 1.213

cruise_power_W.source: P = D V / (eta_prop 0.6 x eta_me 0.85) with D = CD q S; CD0 C0 + 2 nacelles CdA 5.90e-04 m2 + CDi at m 6.910 kg, e x (1 + 0.30 x CT/0.12) (Sinnige); calc.py cruise

endurance_min.source: (144.3 Wh x 0.95 x 0.8 - P_hover x 160 s) / P_cruise (sizing F8-F9); mission needs 10.0 min

parts_new.source: CAD occurrences: Tip_Tube_Ext 2, Tip_Splice_Sleeve 2, Nacelle_Mount 2, Nacelle_Shell 2, Battery_Tray_Ext 1, Tip_Prop_R 1 (new hand), harness 2, ESC_T/CAP_T/motor/spinner/prop relocated (not counted)

parts_removed.source: Pusher_Prop_Set, ESC_P, CAP_P as components (+ J-11 22 pieces, J-29 2 ties); hardware pieces removed 36

risk_basis: structure and drag are low risk; roll inertia x2.07, one-motor-out yaw, prop-ground clearance, thin reserve and a non-Q_ ArduPilot parameter set bring it to medium
trl_note: Layout TRL 4-5: a tip propeller is flown on small aircraft and tunnel-tested at CT 0.12 (Sinnige 2019), but at this aircraft CT 0.028 the drag benefit is unmeasured; ArduPilot twin-throttle/RUDD_DT_GAIN is documented for QuadPlane fixed-wing modes (ardupilot.org/plane/docs/yaw-in-plane.html, 2026-11-02); no flight data for this airframe.
verdict: Do not build as the first aircraft; keep as a later experiment on the C0 wing (tip bore and wire groove are cheap to add during panel cutting).
